description: SPW deposits a synthetic population for Uruguay with household membership and daily activity-location links. The public Zenodo release is CC BY 4.0 and includes a data ZIP, README, contact matrix and validation graphics. Its README names person, household, residential-location, activity-site and activity-assignment CSVs. Input sources include IPUMS households, GPW population counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places. The population can help initialise agent-based national service-demand or evacuation scenarios before routing and hazard data are added. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Uruguay package. A limitation is that the activity contacts were designed for synthetic interaction modelling and do not establish observed public-transport use, site occupancy or evacuation timing. Version 0.9.0 is labelled coarse. The archive was not downloaded, so table counts, address precision and population-weight calibration were not independently checked.
